dataset_role: Manual transcription of five user-supplied poster images for review. This is not a live listing or a database seed.

conventions.missing_value: null means the poster does not visibly state the value or it cannot be read reliably.
conventions.dates: Do not infer a year when the poster does not print one.
conventions.evidence: field_evidence quotes text visible on the poster; ticket logos are not source URLs.
conventions.times: displayed_time preserves the printed time; time_role says whether the poster explicitly identifies it as doors opening.
